title: Differences of the Differences
summary: If the numbers are not steady, study the gaps between them.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Here is a number pattern: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, and then what?
Find the next number, and say how you know.
points: Here is a number pattern: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, and then what?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The numbers do not go up by the same amount each time.
Write down how much each step grows.
points: The numbers do not go up by the same amount each time.

steps.title: The method: Look at the differences
sentences: These steps grow by 2 each time.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The pattern is also n times (n plus 1): 1 times 2, 2 times 3, 3 times 4, 4 times 5, 5 times 6, and next is 6 times 7, which is 42.
When a pattern is not steady, look at the differences between the differences.

quiz.why: These are squares: the next is 6 times 6, which is 36.
